steps.domain_action: The system begins in the Deep, the unmarked void before any distinction.
The monad splits into two arms: the affirmative unit state and the negative refuted state.
The forward morphism maps a value into the monadic context on the T-arm.
The T-arm affirms the pure value, establishing constructive truth.
The reverse morphism descends from the monadic context on the F-arm.
The F-arm refutes the context, establishing constructive falsity.
The bind operation chains the morphisms, linking the output of one action to the input of the next.
The monad recognizes itself, the element is itself, and the weaver becomes the weave.
The system enters the paradice state, holding both the unit and multiplication simultaneously.
The multiplication reconstitutes the nested monad into a single layer, fusing the arms.
The state is fixed as an immutable record, preserving the integer winding characteristics.
The system closes at the boundary, the monad as a singular, indivisible unit.
